entities.summary: The Cathedral-Basilica of Saint Mary is a Roman Catholic church in Ciutadella de Menorca, in the island of Menorca, in Balearic Islands, Spain. It was constructed from 1300 to 1362 in the Catalan Gothic style. It was sacked and desecrated at least twice, in 1558 by the Ottomans and in 1936 during the Spanish Civil War, and restored both times.
